opcoes.rotulo: WITHOUT generated content: HTTP status other than 200, empty body or closed connection

destino.nota: Decision made before the model generated any token — network/API layer, not the LLM itself.

perguntas.pergunta: With status 200, what form does the block text take?

opcoes.rotulo: Standardized: a fixed template (identical for very different requests) or verbose text citing a reason, category or confidence

destino.nota: A standardized template after generation suggests an output monitor/classifier (C5) or a canned trained refusal from the model itself (C4) — not an input filter, since generation already took place.

opcoes.rotulo: Free-form: no template and no structured reason

perguntas.pergunta: How is the latency up to the block?

opcoes.rotulo: Extra latency before the block, or time per token above normal (suggests a secondary call)

destino.nota: Extra latency suggests a classifier or LLM judge running before (C2) or after (C5) the main model.

perguntas.pergunta: What does the refusal look like?

opcoes.rotulo: Articulate and varied: natural language, no template, argues the reason, with normal time per token

destino.nota: CALIBRATION POINT vs. the Haddix heuristic: an articulate refusal here does NOT point only to 'behavioral instruction in the prompt' (C3). In a black box it is indistinguishable from native trained alignment (C4) and from a well-calibrated LLM judge (C2). Treat all three as competing hypotheses.

perguntas.pergunta: What happens when you change a single word of the same request?

destino.nota: The trigger is the word's form, not its meaning — lexical/synonym evasion has a high chance of working.

perguntas.pergunta: What happens when the request is paraphrased or translated?

opcoes.rotulo: The block persists (the trigger seems to be the meaning, not the word)

destino.nota: Robustness to paraphrase rules out a simple lexical filter (C1); it remains ambiguous between a semantic input classifier, prompt hardening and native alignment.

opcoes.rotulo: The block does not persist (the answer is released)

destino.nota: Insufficient signals to converge — repeat the observation (S09, S10) or collect one more sample before building the shortlist.
